definition: Clothing, especially when formal, elaborate, or decorative.
author: Oscar Wilde
quote: It seemed to him that in exquisite raiment, and to the delicate sound of flutes, the sins of the world were passing in dumb show before him.
example_sentence: The choir processed in white raiment.
